name: Monkey Creek Ridge
summary: Del Norte County lookout tower on Monkey Creek Ridge, built 1940 under the Siskiyou National Forest; a 1956 water drop is recorded; listed as gone, with no description of what remains.
design: Timber tower with a cab: the 1940 history gives 10 feet round; survey notes of 1942 and 1952 give about 14 feet square and 20 to 30 feet high
status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower, status Gone; no removal date or description of remains found
agency: Siskiyou National Forest (Forest Lookouts page also files it under Six Rivers National Forest)

events.note: A 10-foot round timber tower with a cab was constructed, per a history of the Siskiyou National Forest quoted on the Forest Lookouts page
Coast and Geodetic Survey station described at the apex of the lookout tower, about 14 by 14 by 20 feet high
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note describes a standard Forest Service lookout house about 14 feet square on legs about 15 feet high, top about 30 feet up
August 1956: fire lookout Eddie Barnard had no nearby water; four five-gallon cans dropped by cargo chute from an airplane
